answer: Qatar Airways Economy carry-on baggage is 1 piece up to 7 kg (15 lb). Checked baggage depends on fare and route: 20–35 kg for most destinations, or 1 piece up to 23 kg (50 lb) on some fares to/from Africa or the Americas. Economy Lite includes 1 checked piece up to 23 kg on those routes; other listed fares include 2 pieces up to 23 kg each. For Brazil flights, the carry-on allowance is 1 piece up to 10 kg (22 lb).
